note: Design queue for tools/shop-engine/design.py. One theme is turned into one design per run, oldest unused first. Add themes freely (the trend autopilot appends trend themes). Rules: original art only; no franchise names, logos, characters or brand art styles; no deity imagery on apparel; Kumaoni text only after a native-speaker check. Themes with art=null are typographic (no AI quota): 'ornament' is aipan | peaks | stars and 'palette' is [text, accent, sub].
